name: MonarchStatusBadge
title: StatusBadge
summary: A status shown as words in a tone, such as "Partial outage", looked up by key in a typed registry of statuses.
whenToUse: For the state of a record or a service that comes from data as a key: an incident, a ticket, a deployment. Define the product's statuses once in a MonarchStatusRegistry so every screen shows the same words and tone.
whenNotToUse: For free text or a count, use MonarchBadge. For a live state next to a name, such as online or recording, use MonarchStatusDot.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStatusBadge(status: String?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchStatusBadgeVariant = MonarchStatusBadgeVariant.Subtle, size: MonarchStatusBadgeSize = MonarchStatusBadgeSize.Md, showIcon: Boolean = true, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = null, label: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchStatusBadge(definition: MonarchStatusDefinition, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchStatusBadgeVariant = MonarchStatusBadgeVariant.Subtle, size: MonarchStatusBadgeSize = MonarchStatusBadgeSize.Md, showIcon: Boolean = true)
class MonarchStatusDefinition(label: String, tone: MonarchTone, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, description: String? = null)

class MonarchStatusRegistry(definitions: Map<String, MonarchStatusDefinition>) { fun resolve(key: String?): MonarchStatusDefinition?; fun merging(other: MonarchStatusRegistry): MonarchStatusRegistry; companion object { val Empty: MonarchStatusRegistry; fun <K : Enum<K>> of(definitions: Map<K, MonarchStatusDefinition>): MonarchStatusRegistry } }
enum class MonarchStatusBadgeVariant { Subtle, Outline, Solid, Dot }

options.name: status
options.description: The key: built-in (operational, degraded, partial, down, maintenance, unknown, success, warning, danger, info, neutral) or from a registry. null is unknown.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm uses caption text, Md label text.

options.name: showIcon
options.description: false hides the icon (and the dot of the dot variant); the label still carries the meaning.

options.name: registry
options.description: Statuses for this badge only, looked up before LocalMonarchStatusRegistry and the built-in set.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the label of the status, for example a translated string.

options.name: icon
options.description: Replaces the icon of the status; in the dot variant it replaces the dot. Hidden from TalkBack.

options.name: definition
options.description: Second overload: the label, tone and icon given directly.

options.name: MonarchStatusDefinition.icon
options.description: A decorative icon before the label.

options.name: MonarchStatusDefinition.description
options.description: One line explaining the status, for a legend the app draws. The badge does not show it.

options.name: mergeSemantics
options.description: Pass false inside a row that merges its children.

states.name: known
states.description: The label and tone of the definition found for the key.

states.name: unknown key
states.description: A key no registry knows is shown in the neutral tone with a label made from the key: "pending_delete" reads "Pending delete".

states.name: null
states.description: Shown as the built-in "Unknown" in the neutral tone.

appearance: Subtle is the subtle background of the tone with its strong text; Outline has no fill, strong text and the border of the tone; Solid is the solid color of the tone with its on-solid text; Dot is default text after a dot in the solid color of the tone (the neutral tone uses the subtle text color). The pill has fully rounded corners. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web registry also accepts a custom #rrggbb color per status, passed through a contrast guard; here colors come only from the theme by role, so a status picks one of the five MonarchTone values. The web accent tone is not offered, because MonarchTone has no accent tone. The web built-in statuses each have a distinct glyph; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the built-in set has none and the app gives icons through MonarchStatusDefinition.icon or the icon parameter. StatusRegistryProvider is LocalMonarchStatusRegistry; nested registries are combined with merging. defineStatuses is MonarchStatusRegistry.of with an enumeration. The parity map lists badge and status-dot as the base; the badge draws its own pill and dot with the same color roles, because MonarchBadge has one text size and MonarchStatusDot reads its dot as part of its own element. iOS shares the name, the variants and the built-in set and uses SF Symbols for the built-in icons.
accessibility: The icon, the dot and the label are one TalkBack element read as the label; the icon and the dot are hidden.
The label is always shown, so the tone is never the only signal.
The badge has no click action and no touch target.
The label wraps at the largest font size instead of being cut off.
edgeCases: A key with no letters, such as "__", reads "Unknown".
The same key in the badge's registry and the provided one: the badge's registry wins.
Statuses of the same tone look alike apart from the label unless the app gives them distinct icons.
